descriptionChirho: Thick, interwoven branches or boughs of a tree, used of dense foliage or thickets (Ezekiel 19:11, 31:3, 31:10, 31:14).

Twisted or braided ropes, cords, and bands used for binding, restraining, or fastening — including literal ropes (as in the Samson narrative), woven cords of the priestly ephod, and figurative bonds or ties (as in Psalm 2:3, Hosea 11:4).
